notes:
• The feed's tint is a setting
• A long section's tint is dimmer than a rail's
• A bridge's own home is tinted, in that bridge's colour
• A rail's tint is round rather than a soft-edged panel
• A rail's tint eases in and out instead of ramping
• Each rail's tint covers its own covers and stops at its edges
• The feed's glows sit on their rails and inside the page
• The aggregate home tints the page behind each rail
• Collections get a tile, the way a Browse source has one
• A card keeps its hover ring while its menu is open
• A collection's first row starts where the library grid's does
• Rows of one list reserve the same hover-action lanes on web
• Settings rows run the full width of the desktop settings pane
• Desktop right-click menu no longer offers "Inspect element"
• Web menu fades its frosted panel, not the box around it
• Collection tiles take the series card's cover frame and learned aspect
• Share the series card's cover corner with collection tiles and skeletons
• Desktop collection tiles: the type chip clears the rounder corner
• Collection tiles get a menu
• Collection tiles carry the series card's title and sub line
